cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Response: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to cancel the effect of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck. Shuffle that card back into the encounter deck and reveal another encounter card.
cards.flavor: "I will take the Ring," he said, "though I do not know the way." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Black Steed
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Attach to a Nazgûl enemy in play, if able. (Counts a Mount attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per enemy. Attached enemy gets -10 engagement cost and gains. 'Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, return attached enemy to the staging area.'")

cards.name: Bag End
cards.text: Response: After Bag End leaves play, each player draws 1 card for each Hobbit hero he controls.

cards.name: Rode Like a Gale
cards.text: When Revealed: Return each engaged Nazgûl enemy to the staging area.  If no enemies were returned to the staging area by this effect, Rode Like a Gale gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

cards.name: Stock-Brook
cards.text: When Revealed: Immediately travel to Stock-Brook.  If another location is currently active, return it to the staging area.

cards.name: Have You Seen Baggins?
cards.text:
Peril. Surge.
When Revealed: Attach to a hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per hero. Forced: After a player fails a Hide test, discard attached hero.")

cards.name: Pathless Country
cards.text: Pathless Country gets +4 quest points while in the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: After this attack, the attacking enemy engages the next player then makes an immediate attack.

cards.name: The Marish
cards.text: Forced: After a player fails a Hide test, shuffle a Nazgûl enemy from the discard pile into the encounter deck, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if the defending player failed a Hide test this round).

cards.name: A Shortcut to Mushrooms
cards.back_text: When Revealed: The first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a Black Rider, reveals it (cannot be cancelled), and adds it to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.  When a player makes a Hide test, add 1 to the total [threat] for each ally that player controls.  When a player fails a Hide test, each Nazgûl enemy in the staging area engages that player. (Trigger Forced effects after resolving this effect.)

cards.name: Lure of the Ring
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: The first player must either exhaust The One Ring or raise his threat by 3.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if The One Ring is exhausted).

cards.name: Bucklebury Ferry
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
While there is at least 1 other location in play, the players cannot travel here.  Travel: The first player must make a Hide 3 test to travel here.  After Bucklebury Ferry leaves play as an explored location, the players win the game.

cards.name: Black Rider
cards.text:
Hide 2. Cannot have non-Morgul attachments.
Forced: After engaged player fails a Hide test, Black Rider makes an immediate attack.

cards.name: Three is Company
cards.text: Setup: Set Bucklebury Ferry aside, out of play.  Add 1 Black Rider to the staging area and make Bag End the active location.  Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: When a player fails a Hide test, each Nazgûl enemy in the staging area engages that player. (Trigger Forced effects after resolving this effect.)  The players cannot advance unless Bag End is in the victory display.

cards.name: Escape to Buckland
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Bucklebury Ferry to the staging area.
cards.back_text: When Revealed: The first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a Black Rider, reveals it (cannot be cancelled), and adds it to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.  When a player fails a Hide test, each Nazgûl enemy in the staging area engages that player. (Trigger Forced effects after resolving this effect.)  Response: After a player makes a successful Hide test, place X progress on a non-unique location in play.  X is twice the number of players in the game.

cards.name: Crawling Towards Him
cards.text:
Peril. Hide 2.
When Revealed: If you have failed a Hide test this phase, remove each character you control form the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

cards.name: Piercing Cry
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Nazgûl enemy. Either add it to the staging area or put it into play engaged with the first player.  Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Bamfurlong
cards.text: Response: After the players travel to Bamfurlong, each player engaged with a Nazgûl enemy may ready a hero he controls.

cards.name: Stock Road
cards.text: While Stock Road is in the staging area, add 2 to the total [threat] of the discarded cards when a player resolves a Hide test.  Travel: The first player must make a Hide 1 test to travel here.

cards.name: Green Hill Country
cards.text: While Green Hill Country is the active location, characters get +1 [willpower] while committed to Hide tests.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if you have failed a Hide test this round).

cards.name: Hunting For The Ring
cards.text:
Doomed 2.
When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player much either return a Nazgûl enemy engaged with him to the staging area or make a Hide 2 test.

cards.name: Woody End
cards.text: While Woody End is the Active location, reduce each Hide X value by 1.

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.text: Setup: The first player claims The One Ring and attaches it to the Ring-bearer.  Attached hero does not count against the hero limit. The first player gains control of the attached hero.  If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Evil Crow
cards.text: While Evil Crow is engaged with a player, that player adds 1 to the Hide value for each Hide test he makes.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If you have failed a Hide test this round, this attack is considered undefended.
